summary: F4 confirms a phishing email from docusign-aegean-share.com with a purchase-contract signature subject. F1 shows impossible travel from Amsterdam to Gravelines in 15 minutes. F2 confirms a suspicious sign-in from DigitalOcean NL (AS14061) outside the account baseline. F3 confirms the user clicked the phishing link. Escalate per Risk Gate despite no confirmed abuse chain.

actions.action: Reset the user password and force MFA re-registration; review and invalidate sign-in sessions from AS14061 and Amsterdam/Gravelines.
Block docusign-aegean-share.com at the email gateway and web proxy; search mailboxes for duplicate phishing messages.
Interview the user about the clicked link and check for credential entry, OAuth grants, or mailbox changes.

limitations: Rejected password-spray claim; 193.140.10.44 is shared egress with 204 MFA successes in 30 days, so no coordinated spray confirmed.

risk.rationale: Verified findings form a coherent account takeover chain: phishing-suspect mail delivered (F4, T1566.002), user clicked the malicious link (F3, T1204.001), followed by a sign-in from a non-baseline ASN (DigitalOcean NL, F2, T1078.004) and impossible travel Amsterdam→Gravelines in 15 min (F1, T1078.004). All four findings are CONFIRMED. The rejected password-spray claim is explained away as shared-egress background noise and does not undermine the confirmed chain. This meets the contain threshold (confirmed account takeover chain).
